profile.onboarding: Early tutorial levels introduce jumping and power-ups one at a time before combining them.
profile.controls: Move plus jump, with a separate camera stick to look around the course.
profile.core_loop: Roll and jump through a 3D course to the finish line, then optionally chase a faster medal time.
profile.goals_and_rewards: Finishing earns gems and a medal tier based on time; gems and progress unlock new marble skins.
profile.difficulty_curve: Moderate for a first clear, with real depth for players chasing gold-medal speed-run times.
profile.game_feel: Responsive controls with a satisfying sense of momentum and weight to the marble.
profile.usability: Restarting after a fall or miss is nearly instant, minimizing downtime.
profile.accessibility: Requires coordinating movement, jump, and camera together, plus timer-based goals, which is more demanding than a single-input game.
profile.ads_and_purchases: Paid up-front game with cosmetic DLC; no ads or forced purchases in core play.
profile.notes: Useful for comparing whether Rolly Bally's ball unlocks feel earned through play (like here) versus gated behind a store.
